title: New White House Counsel Isn’t a Yes Man, but He Won’t Say No, Either
summary: Will Scharf has proved his loyalty to President Trump, even filming a TV ad in which he blows away documents from the president’s legal cases. His new role will be to provide in-house legal advice.
